items.title: Add machine-readable story authority resolver JSON surface
items.context: Create or extend a L0 read-only Lattice command returning active stories with storyId, title, authority, mirrorPhase, authoritativePhase, authoritativeCwd, and worktreePath. It must avoid Markdown parsing and must report productionDone/receiptVerified false unless a verified receipt path exists.
items.userSees: Running lattice story_authority_resolve --format=json prints schemaVersion=lattice.story_authority_resolve.v1 and active story rows with authoritativeCwd resolved before story_export.

happy.desc: lattice story_authority_resolve --format=json returns schemaVersion, readOnly=true, and active story rows with required resolver fields.

edge.desc: When a story has authority:worktree and mirrorPhase differs, resolver returns authoritativePhase from the worktree and authoritativeCwd pointing at the worktree.

adversarial.desc: Resolver does not parse session_brief/status Markdown and cannot set productionDone, receiptVerified, or authorityChanged true.

items.title: Build read-only observability adapter skeleton
items.context: Add a core adapter that consumes the resolver output, runs story_export from the authoritative cwd, and prepares normalized inputs for Authority Ladder, Story Board, Capability Matrix, Recovery, and Parallel views without building UI.
items.userSees: Running lattice observability_snapshot --format=json emits a dry-run read-only snapshot with resolver rows plus normalized Authority Ladder, Story Board, Capability Matrix, Recovery, and Parallel input sections.

happy.desc: lattice observability_snapshot --format=json returns normalized sections for authority ladder, story board, capability matrix, recovery, and parallel planning inputs.

edge.desc: Snapshot runs story_export from each resolver authoritativeCwd rather than repo root when worktree authority is present.

adversarial.desc: Snapshot does not read .koala/story or docs/story backing JSON directly and does not build or modify the terminal dashboard UI.

items.title: Register L0 policy and schema contracts
items.context: Register the new resolver/adapter command policy and process fact level as read-only L0. Document exact schema names and keep every authority field conservative: productionDone false, receiptVerified false, authorityChanged false.
items.userSees: Running command policy/process fact smoke tests shows story_authority_resolve and observability_snapshot are L0 read-only diagnostics, and calling them does not create evidence, receipt, lifecycle, or authority events.

happy.desc: New resolver/snapshot commands are registered in command policy and process fact levels as L0 read-only diagnostics.

edge.desc: Both commands retain conservative authority fields: productionDone=false, receiptVerified=false, authorityChanged=false.

adversarial.desc: Invoking resolver/snapshot cannot append lifecycle/evidence/receipt/authority process events or satisfy gate evidence.

items.title: Add smoke coverage for worktree authority and no overclaim
items.context: Add focused tests proving worktree authority beats main mirror, UI/adapter code does not parse session_brief Markdown, no direct .koala/story or docs/story JSON reads are used by adapter, and no path can manufacture production authority.
items.userSees: Validation output includes focused smoke coverage proving worktree authority wins over stale main mirror, no Markdown parsing is required, no backing-store direct reads are used by the adapter, and no command manufactures production DONE.

happy.desc: Focused smoke commands pass for resolver, snapshot adapter, and policy contract.

edge.desc: Smoke fixture covers stale main mirror versus authoritative worktree and verifies authoritativeCwd is used.

adversarial.desc: Tests fail if implementation parses session_brief/status Markdown, directly reads backing story JSON from adapter, or claims productionDone/receiptVerified.
